# labmate.tools

> Free, browser-based calculators and bench tools for life science labs. Independent and vendor-neutral; no sign-up; what users type stays in their browser. Each tool page shows its formula, a worked example, reference values and an FAQ.

## Plates

- [Well Plate Pipetting Tracker (96 & 384)](https://labmate.tools/tools/plate-tracker/): Free well plate pipetting tracker for iPad, laptop and phone. Tap each well as you load a 96 or 384 well plate and track up to 8 reagents in rounds.
- [96 & 384 Well Plate Layout Maker](https://labmate.tools/tools/plate-layout/): Free 96 and 384 well plate layout maker. Paste samples, add controls and replicates, skip edge wells, then print the plate map or download a CSV.

## Calculators

- [Master Mix Calculator for PCR & qPCR](https://labmate.tools/tools/master-mix/): Free PCR and qPCR master mix calculator. List reagents per reaction, set reactions and overage, top up with water, then copy or print the table.
- [Dilution Calculator (C1V1 = C2V2)](https://labmate.tools/tools/dilution/): Free C1V1 = C2V2 dilution calculator. Solve for stock or final volume or concentration in any unit, with stock and diluent volumes ready to pipette.
- [Molarity Calculator — Mass & mg/mL to µM](https://labmate.tools/tools/molarity/): Free molarity calculator: grams to weigh for any volume and concentration, or the molarity you made. Convert mg/mL and ng/µL to µM with the molecular weight.
- [Serial Dilution Calculator, Tube by Tube](https://labmate.tools/tools/serial-dilution/): Free serial dilution calculator. Set top concentration, fold, tubes and volume; get diluent and transfer volumes for every tube and a printable plan.
- [qPCR ΔΔCt & Pfaffl Relative Quantification](https://labmate.tools/tools/qpcr/): Free qPCR relative quantification in the browser: open the Cq export from Bio-Rad CFX, QuantStudio, LightCycler, Rotor-Gene or RDML, average and check replicates, correct for efficiency, normalise to the geometric mean of several reference genes, and get fold changes with log-scale error bars, Welch t-tests, CSV, chart and a methods paragraph.
- [Cloning Reaction Calculator (Ligation, Gibson/HiFi, Golden Gate)](https://labmate.tools/tools/cloning/): Free cloning reaction calculator: every fragment’s length and ng/µL give ng ↔ pmol ↔ nM, the insert:vector molar ratio the protocol in force asks for, the µL to pipette with master mix, buffer, enzyme and water, checks on total DNA, unpurified PCR product and volumes that will not fit, and a printable pipetting sheet.
- [Buffer Recipe Calculator (10× stocks & 1× working solutions)](https://labmate.tools/tools/buffer-recipes/): Free buffer recipe calculator: Tris-glycine-SDS running buffer, Towbin transfer buffer, TBS/TBST, PBS/PBST, TAE, TBE, RIPA and gel stocks (1.5 M Tris pH 8.8, 0.5 M Tris pH 6.8, 10% SDS, 10% APS, 0.5 M EDTA), each with its source. Grams and millilitres for any strength and volume, or how to dilute an N× stock with methanol or Tween added at use; powder, neat liquid or stock solution per component; edit any recipe or build your own.
- [DNA & RNA Normalization Calculator (NanoDrop, Qubit)](https://labmate.tools/tools/nucleic-acid-normalization/): Free DNA and RNA normalization calculator. Paste or open a NanoDrop One/Eight/8000/2000 or Qubit 4/Flex export (or a plain name and ng/µL list); set the same ng per tube (or the same ng/µL) and the final volume; get sample and water volumes rounded to pipette steps, 260/280 and 260/230 flags for DNA or RNA with likely causes, pre-dilutions for samples under the smallest pipetting volume, too-dilute warnings with the largest equal amount, averaging of repeat readings, a tube list or 96/384-well plate map, a printable pipetting sheet with tick boxes, Excel and CSV files, and a liquid-handler worklist (generic CSV or Tecan .gwl).

## Converters

- [RPM to g Calculator (RCF Converter)](https://labmate.tools/tools/rpm-to-g/): Free centrifuge RPM to g (RCF) converter. Enter your rotor radius to turn × g into rpm or rpm into × g, and match a protocol written for another centrifuge.

## Labels

- [Cryo Label Maker for Laser Label Sheets](https://labmate.tools/tools/cryo-labels/): Free cryo label maker: turn a list of sample IDs into a print-ready PDF for laser cryogenic label sheets, with a calibration page for your printer.

## Cells & Protein

- [Cell Seeding & Hemocytometer Calculator](https://labmate.tools/tools/cell-seeding/): Free hemocytometer and cell seeding calculator: square counts to live cells/mL and viability, then cell suspension and medium volumes for any plate or flask.
- [Western Blot Loading Calculator (BCA)](https://labmate.tools/tools/protein-loading/): Free BCA/Bradford standard curve and Western blot loading calculator: protein per sample, then sample, buffer and water volumes for equal µg per lane.
- [Western Blot Densitometry](https://labmate.tools/tools/blot-densitometry/): Free in-browser Western blot band quantification: reads raw values from 8/16/32-bit TIFF and PNG, equal-size band boxes with local background, saturation checks, normalisation to a loading control, CSV, ImageJ macro and a re-openable project file. Never uploaded.
- [Cell Doubling Time Calculator](https://labmate.tools/tools/doubling-time/): Free cell doubling time calculator for a whole batch of cultures: start and end counts with times give population doublings, doubling time and specific growth rate μ, with the working shown, split correction, cumulative doublings per cell line, CSV/JSON export and a printable worksheet.
- [ELISA Standard Curve Analyzer (4PL / 5PL)](https://labmate.tools/tools/elisa/): Free ELISA analysis in the browser, in English or Chinese: open or paste the plate reader export (BioTek Gen5, SoftMax Pro, Tecan, BMG MARS, Thermo SkanIt, PerkinElmer, Bio-Rad or any 8×12 block), tap the 96-well layout, fit a weighted 4PL or 5PL curve with convergence checks, and get concentrations × each sample's dilution with replicate CV, standard and control recovery, LLOQ/ULOQ and LOD, how much to re-dilute out-of-range samples, a printable report, CSV and a re-openable record. Sandwich and competitive assays.
- [SDS-PAGE Gel Recipe Calculator](https://labmate.tools/tools/sds-page-gel/): Free SDS-PAGE gel recipe calculator: Bio-Rad Mini-PROTEAN 0.75/1.0/1.5 mm cassettes or any plate size, number of gels with overage, up to four resolving percentages at once plus the stacking gel, from your own 30%/40% acrylamide, Tris, SDS and APS stocks; volumes in order of addition, exact-total or as-printed water, printable recipe cards. Checked against the Bio-Rad manual and published lab recipes.

## Print

- [Conference Poster Print Check](https://labmate.tools/tools/poster-check/): Free conference poster print check: compare your PDF or PPTX with the print size and board limit, and check image resolution and text size. Never uploaded.

## Cytometry

- [Flow Cytometry Panel Designer](https://labmate.tools/tools/panel-designer/): Free, vendor-neutral flow cytometry panel designer. Pick your cytometer, assign fluorochromes and see spectra, estimated spillover and spectral similarity.
- [Flow Antibody Titration Calculator](https://labmate.tools/tools/antibody-titration/): Free flow cytometry antibody titration calculator: serial or tube-by-tube dilution series in µg or µL per test with predilutions under 0.5 µL, then paste a FlowJo / FCS Express statistics table to get the stain index (Maecker 2004), 84th-percentile separation index or signal-to-noise, the best and lowest near-best amount, chart and CSV.
- [Flow Staining Cocktail Calculator](https://labmate.tools/tools/staining-cocktail/): Free flow cytometry staining cocktail calculator: antibodies in µL/test, µg/test or 1:X × number of tubes with % or whole-tube extra, buffer to volume, Brilliant Stain Buffer and Fc block, predilution for volumes under 0.5 µL, fixable viability dye listed apart, import from Panel Designer, printable sheet, CSV and share link.

## Imaging

- [Microscopy Scale Bar Maker](https://labmate.tools/tools/scale-bar/): Free batch scale bar maker for microscope images. Enter µm per pixel, measure a stage micrometer or read the Fiji / OME-TIFF scale, add the same bar to PNG, JPG or TIFF images and export copies with a CSV calibration record. Never uploaded.
- [Microscopy Nyquist Calculator — Pixel Size, Zoom & Z-Step](https://labmate.tools/tools/nyquist/): Free Nyquist sampling calculator for widefield, point-scanning confocal, spinning disk and two-photon. Pick objectives, cameras and confocal systems from Nikon, Evident, Zeiss, Leica, Hamamatsu, Teledyne Photometrics, Andor and Yokogawa by brand and model (each with its spec-sheet source, data CC BY 4.0) or type every value; get Rayleigh resolution, Nyquist pixel size and z-step per channel (SVI definitions), the camera adapter, binning or confocal zoom that reaches it, tube-lens correction across brands, spinning-disk pinhole in Airy units, a printable settings card, share link and µm/px hand-off to the Scale Bar Maker.

## Animals

- [Rodent Dosing Calculator & Dosing Sheet (mg/kg)](https://labmate.tools/tools/dosing/): Free mouse and rat dosing calculator. Paste a batch of body weights to get every animal's dose volume in mL, rounded to your syringe, the formulation recipe (vehicle components, stock, overage, multi-day courses), checks against good-practice and maximum dosing volumes per route (Diehl 2001, a conservative set, or your institution's limits), and a printable dosing sheet.

## Planning

- [Protocol Timeline Planner — Western Blot, IHC & Multi-Group Lab Scheduling](https://labmate.tools/tools/protocol-timeline/): Free protocol timeline planner. Editable templates (western blot, IHC on paraffin, immunofluorescence, lipofection, sandwich ELISA, co-IP, RNA to qPCR, plasmid miniprep) or your own steps, each with a time, a shortest–longest window and the minutes you are hands-on. Plans forward from a start time or backward from a deadline, staggers several groups so hands-on steps never clash (1–3 people), keeps a per-group buffer and a per-step buffer, stretches flexible incubations to keep hands-on work inside the working day, shows overnight leave and return windows, and exports a calendar file with alarms, a printable bench card and a plain-text schedule. Bench mode follows the plan live on a phone (countdowns, beep when you are needed, screen kept on) and re-plans each time a step is marked done; a share link rebuilds the plan on another device; works offline once opened.

## About

- [About labmate.tools](https://labmate.tools/about/): who makes it, where values come from and how they are checked.
- [Privacy](https://labmate.tools/privacy/): no accounts; tool inputs never leave the browser.
- [Contact](https://labmate.tools/contact/): question, problem report or tool request form; `?topic=<tool-slug>` preselects the tool.
- [Changelog](https://labmate.tools/CHANGELOG.md): what changed, newest first.
